result:
Each query is a first attempt from the page alone, so none was run. A few steps rest on guesses the page doesn't settle:
- how `groupBy` takes its key,
- whether `at` accepts a null subject,
- whether `split` leaves a trailing empty string.

R1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(/address | type | eq ::map) | filter ~(/address | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * /name | sort
R2: filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~/customer * (* (/items * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
R6: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
R7: trim | lines * (split " " | {:path /2 :status (/3 | parseJson)}) | filter ~(/status | gte 500) * /path | distinct | sort
R8: trim | lines * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") * (/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: trim | lines | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~/1 * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: trim | lines | drop 1 * (split "," | /3 | split ";") | flat | filter ~(ne "") * lower | distinct | sort
R11: lines * trim | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * (split "=" | [(/0 | trim) (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)]) | filter ~(/0 | startsWith "DB_") * [(/0 | drop 3 | lower) /1] | tag ::map
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~/name
R13: {:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (/meta | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "date" "Elder" "cherry" "fig" "Apple"] * lower | groupBy * count | filter ~(gt 1) | keys * keyword | sort
